host: Windows with a locally built eki-control, an embedded SQLite state store, generated Ed25519 keys, and a seeded policy row
command: eki-control --config dispatch.json (dispatch enabled, policy epoch 1 seeded), then POST /v1/tasks with the projected TaskRequest
scope: Shows that a seeded policy lets the placement loop consider the Task, but placement stops because no Worker is registered. It does not register a Worker or verify execution.
